scenes.headline: How Scion serves a monorepo to thousands of agents
scenes.sub: Anthropic swapped git for a server-centric version control system.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Skein! Here is how Anthropic rebuilt source control for agents.

steps.say: In May the monorepo merged about two and a half thousand changes a day.
By September, one day hit thirty thousand. The weekly average was nearer eighteen thousand.

scenes.label: between landings at 30,000 a day
scenes.note: anything serialized must finish inside it
scenes.say: At thirty thousand a day, a change lands every two point eight eight seconds. Any lock on main must release that fast.

left.title: Git
items: Server builds a pack per client
left.say: In git, every clone is a full server, fetches are computed per client, and pushes to main race.

right.title: Scion
items: Client asks for objects by hash
A ref moves by one CAS
right.say: In Scion, the server is the repository. Clients cache what they read.

steps.say: A job asks only for the objects it is missing, by hash.
The node's daemon answers most. Misses go to a regional cache.
Only then does the server read Spanner and cloud storage.

items.say: The server appends a changeset listing only the changed files.
Trees and blame are derived data.
Publishing is one compare and swap on a single row.
There is no global merge lock. Tests run after landing.

scenes.title: Why the merge queue had to go

parts.say: A queue holding the lock for s seconds per change
lands at most a day's seconds over s. Five minute tests cap it near three hundred.

scenes.title: Checkout in a CI job, median
scenes.say: Anthropic reports a CI checkout median of thirty one seconds on git, three and a half on Scion.

scenes.text: Make repository questions an API, objects cacheable by hash, and the serialized step one tiny write.
scenes.mark: the serialized step one tiny write
scenes.say: Make repository questions an API, objects cacheable by hash, and the serialized step one tiny write.

recap: Fetch asks for wanted hashes only
Land with a CAS, test after
scenes.say: The server owns history, clients fetch by hash, and main moves with one write.
